invariants.rationale: This expresses the assignment performed in updateAnimationBaseTime right as the method is about to execute.
Offsets for timing are typically non-negative; a reasonable invariant unless class design allows negative offsets.
Render time, representing an epoch time in milliseconds, is expected to be non-negative.
System time in milliseconds is non-negative since epoch.
The time since epoch should generally be greater than or equal to the offset used for animation timing.
